dedupe_keys.name: latvia melioration cadastre agricultural and forest drainage systems drainpipes ditches polder pumping stations dams and culverts zmni wfs

description: The Latvian melioration cadastre is the national register of land drainage infrastructure, kept by the Ministry of Agriculture's state real estate company and published through the ĢEOLatvija.lv spatial data platform. Contents: agricultural drainage systems with about 6.9 million drainpipe segments and drain collectors, 160,143 ditch segments with chainage pickets, state-significance watercourses (lines, polygons and pickets) and state-controlled rivers, 48 polder territories with their catchments and 57 polder pumping stations, 124 dams, 56,208 transport structures such as culverts and bridges on drainage channels, network structures, decommissioned systems and drainage catchments; forest drainage ditches are included and the cadastre is still being completed. Producer: VSIA Zemkopības ministrijas nekustamie īpašumi. Coverage: the whole of Latvia. Format and access: an INSPIRE hydrography WFS 2.0 with 20 feature types and a WMS, reached through the state data distribution service with no registration; the platform lists the product with irregular updates. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0. Caveats: the drainpipe layer is very large, so downloads should be tiled by area; attributes for age and condition vary by system; commercial reuse is not allowed under the licence. Simulation uses: rural drainage and polder pumping in flood and waterlogging models, exposure of culverts and dams to extreme rainfall, and asset ageing studies of drainage networks. Related records: the Estonian land improvement register (data-estonia-land-improvement-drainage-systems-register) holds the same kind of data for Estonia.
